5411.name: Dawn Mulsum
desc:
A sweet drink often offered to the
Goddess, Altana. It is first mentioned
in the holy scripture in Trepidations IX.

"Ye cannot drink the cup of the
Goddess, and the cup of Daemons."

5412.name: Scapegoat
desc:
This quaint depiction of a goat
was carved from a single marid tusk.
It is said to contain a single phoenix
feather.

5413.name: Smoldering Lamp
desc:
A thin trail of smoke slowly rises from
this ornate bronze lamp.

5414.name: Glowing Lamp
desc:
An eerie light radiates forth from
the dark flame within this ornate
bronze lamp.

5415.name: Hero's Reflections
desc:
A page taken from the autobiography
of legendary hero, Balrahn. Contains
invaluable information on the arts of
war and governing.

Lv.60 All Jobs

5416.name: Stl. Bull. Pouch
desc:
This leather pouch is used to
carry large quantities of steel bullets.

5417.name: Toolbag (Sanja)
desc:
This leather pouch is used to carry
large quantities of the ninja tool
sanjaku-tenugui.

5418.name: Tincture
desc:
A potent concotion developed by
Rhinostery researchers.

5419.name: Black Mine
desc: A jet black, goblin-engineered, incendiary device designed for subterranean placement. Propels iron shrapnel in all directions upon detonation.

5420.name: Paralyzing Tube
desc: An ingenious levitating smart-mine conceived of by Bastokan officer Adelheid Sturm. Causes only nearby enemies to become paralyzed upon detonation.

5421.name: Silencing Tube
desc: An ingenious levitating smart-mine conceived of by Bastokan officer Adelheid Sturm. Causes only nearby enemies to become silenced upon detonation.

5422.name: Binding Tube
desc: An ingenious levitating smart-mine conceived of by Bastokan officer Adelheid Sturm. Causes only nearby enemies to become bound upon detonation.

5423.name: Bottled Fay
desc:
Rumored to possess the power
to return the bearer to a previous
location if released. You remembered
to punch holes in the lid.

5424.name: Serene Serinette
desc: An exquisite miniature barrel organ housed in a wooden case of finely polished walnut. Turning its tiny crank causes it to play a gently soothing melody.

5425.name: Joyous Serinette
desc: An exquisite miniature barrel organ housed in a wooden case of finely polished walnut. Turning its tiny crank causes it to play a rousing celebratory march.

5426.name: Maze Compass
desc:
A makeshift compass manufactured
by Moblin Maze Mongers.
It allows for a quick and easy
escape from any maze.

5427.name: Maze Pearl
desc:
A refurbished linkpearl provided free
of charge by Moblin Maze Mongers.
It can be used to contact Chatnachoq,
who will provide valuable advice
for spelunking adventurers.

5428.name: Instant Retrace
desc:
The black magic spell Retrace
is inscribed on this parchment.

5429.name: Tjn. Wildgrass
desc:
A type of wildgrass used to heighten
the olfactory senses of chocobos.

5430.name: Viper Potion

This potion instantly restores
a few HP.

This potion instantly restores
a few MP.

This potion instantly restores

5434.name: Fanatic's Drink
desc:
This medicine temporarily
nullifies all physical damage.

5435.name: Fool's Drink
desc:
This medicine temporarily
nullifies all magical damage.

5436.name: Dusty Reraise
desc:
The white magic spell Reraise

5437.name: Strange Milk

5438.name: Strange Juice

Juice, freshly squeezed
from something strange...

This medicine instantly
cures most status ailments.

When used, these man-made wings
instantly raise TP. Due to muscle
strain, repeated use is prohibited.

5441.name: Angelwing

A supranatural firework created by
a Goblin alchemist.

5442.name: Thunderguard Dart

This dart has been dipped in

subduing large game.

5444.name: Grauberg Greens

5445.name: Prismatic Elixir
desc: When held into the light, this elixir shimmers with all the colors of the rainbow.

5446.name: Red Bubble-Eye
desc:
As its name implies, the area
around the eyes of this red
freshwater goldfish from the
Far East is round and swollen.

5447.name: Denizanasi

This monstrous jellyfish has caused
Al Zahbi fishermen many headaches.

5448.name: Kalamar
desc:
This cephalopod's most recognizable
feature is its pointy shell.

5449.name: Hamsi

This saltwater fish lives in the
Sicklemoon Straits.

5450.name: Lakerda

This enormous saltwater fish wanders
the Cyan Deep.

the "Sword of Cyan."

5452.name: Uskumru

the Cyan Deep.

silver stripes.

5464.name: Kaplumbaga

Near East.

5466.name: Trumpet Shell

Also known as the "Don of the Deep,"

the Bastore Sea.

5468.name: Matsya

This legendary saltwater fish is said

5469.name: Brass Loach

5474.name: Ca Cuong

5475.name: Gigant Octopus

home beneath the boulders that litter
the floor of the Bastore Sea.

5476.name: Abaia

desc: This massive hunk of raw lucerewe flesh has a unique pungency not completely unlike that of a sopping wet Mithra.

5532.name: Ichinin. Koma
desc: A traditional type of firework that mimics the twirls and twists of a spinning top. The technology behind it has supposedly been handed down from generation to generation in the Far East.

5534.name: Apkallufa
desc: This freshwater fish's resemblance to an apkallu is so striking that it fools many dim-witted Adoulinian collectors into believing it is the real bird. The only thing the two animals truly share is their habitat of Marjami Ravine.

5535.name: Deademoiselle
desc: Despite its elegant appearance, the fact that this fish navigates the estuaries it calls home with its belly up takes most Adoulinians aback the first time they lay eyes on it.

5536.name: Yorchete
desc: Shaped like a knife, this aquatic cutlery slices its way through the waters of Yorcia Weald with a force unrivaled by any of its other finned brethren.

5537.name: Soryu

is so exquisite that they were
once available only to royalty.

the Starlight Celebration.
